mapper.select: SELECT smrd.ownr_nm , smrd.rcvr_sn , CAST(AES_DECRYPT(FROM_BASE64(smrd.telno), 'theimc') AS CHAR(100) CHARACTER SET UTF8MB4) AS telno , aar.rpt_ymd , CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(aar.rpt_ymd, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y년 %m월'), ' 월간 리포트가 생성되었습니다.') AS report_title , aar.reg_dt , aar.msg_cn from svc_msg_rcvr_data smrd LEFT OUTER JOIN anls_ai_rpt aar ON smrd.ownr_nm = aar.ownr_nm WHERE 1 = 1 AND msg_cn IS NOT NULL AND smrd.ai_rpt_rcptn_yn = 'Y' AND aar.rpt_ymd = CURRENT_DATE

SELECT sub.rcvr_sn, sub.ownr_nm, CAST(AES_DECRYPT(FROM_BASE64(sub.telno), 'theimc') AS CHAR(100) CHARACTER SET UTF8MB4) AS telno,
GROUP_CONCAT(sub.reg_no ORDER BY sub.scr ASC SEPARATOR '\n') AS reg_no_list FROM ( SELECT s.rcvr_sn, r.ownr_nm, r.reg_no, r.scr, s.telno, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY r.ownr_nm, s.telno ORDER BY r.scr ASC, r.reg_no ASC ) AS rn FROM anls_vhcl_stts_rt r INNER JOIN svc_msg_rcvr_data s ON r.ownr_nm = s.ownr_nm WHERE s.chck_rcptn_yn = 'Y' AND r.scr >= 60 AND r.scr <= 70 ) sub WHERE sub.rn <= 5 GROUP BY sub.ownr_nm, sub.telno ORDER BY sub.ownr_nm, sub.telno
